verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pylon has an API used with a bearer token and an MCP server that authenticates via OAuth and acts "within the data you can see in Pylon." That OAuth access inherits the signed-in user's visibility; it is not a way to issue a separate scoped or least-privilege credential for an agent. Nothing in the pack documents scoped API keys, per-token permissions, or agent-specific credentials, so the related capabilities are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
